caption_used: Distribution of articles across the three-year collection period (2017-2019), displayed as a pie chart with percentage and count labels. The 2019 cohort (blue) represents the largest share at 46.0% (46 articles), followed by 2018 (orange) at 33.0% (33 articles) and 2017 (green) at 21.0% (21 articles). The distribution reflects a steady annual increase, with the 2018-to-2019 growth rate of approximately 25% exceeding the 2017-to-2018 growth rate of roughly 35%. The combined 2017-2018 corpus accounts for slightly over half of all articles at 54%, suggesting that the collection effort intensified primarily in the final year.

raw_responses.English: DESCRIPTION: The pie chart displays the distribution of articles across three years—2017, 2018, and 2019—within a three-year collection period. It consists of three slices, each representing a year and labeled with both the year and its corresponding percentage and count. The largest slice, colored blue, corresponds to 2019 and accounts for 46.0% (46 articles). The second largest slice, colored orange, represents 2018 at 33.0% (33 articles). The smallest slice, colored green, represents 2017 at 21.0% (21 articles). Each slice includes percentage and count labels positioned inside, and the years are labeled adjacent to their respective slices. The slices are arranged in descending order of size, starting with 2019 at the top and proceeding clockwise. There is no legend, and no slices are visually emphasized through offsetting or other effects.
